Role Summary

As the AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore), you will lead live incident coordination during offshore hours and provide structured command for production issues impacting the clients AI support environment. We need someone who can rapidly size the situation, confirm severity, engage the right teams, keep the bridge disciplined, and maintain an accurate view of what is happening technically. This role sits close to the work: you should be comfortable coordinating engineers, reviewing evidence, challenging weak updates, and preparing clean handoffs to the onshore lead and client stakeholders when needed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live incident command and technical coordination

  • Lead Severity 1, Severity 2, and priority production incidents during offshore coverage, including bridge setup, severity confirmation, responder coordination, action tracking, and restoration cadence.
  • Drive structured technical triage across SRE, platform, integration, application, service desk, security, and vendor teams so incidents continue moving and do not stall in ambiguity.
  • Maintain a current command view of symptoms, likely causes, actions in progress, risks, dependencies, and next decisions required.

2. Handoffs, escalation, and operational discipline

  • Prepare concise, high-quality handoffs to the onshore lead with clear incident status, unresolved risks, owners, timestamps, and recommended next actions.
  • Escalate early when severity, business impact, stakeholder sensitivity, or technical uncertainty requires broader engagement or onshore leadership attention.
  • Ensure ticket hygiene, bridge notes, timelines, and action logs are complete enough to support RCA, reporting, and clean follow-through.

3. Change risk, problem management, and improvement support

  • Support operational readiness for risky changes, releases, and maintenance activities by asking the right questions about rollback, validation, monitoring, and support readiness.
  • Contribute incident evidence and technical observations into post-incident reviews and corrective-action planning.
  • Identify repeat failure patterns, weak runbooks, and support-process gaps, then push improvements back into the service.

4. Stakeholder engagement and team ways of working

  • Work closely with the onshore incident lead, offshore engineers, resolver groups, vendors, and service leadership to keep decision-making and recovery aligned.
  • Engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work rather than waiting for direction when an incident is already live.
  • Create structure in fast-moving situations and help less experienced responders operate with clarity and confidence.

Preferred Skills and Experience


Major incident leadership

Experience coordinating high-severity production incidents, including bridge management, severity assessment, action tracking, and restoration management.

Technical support depth

Enough technical depth to follow cloud, application, integration, and observability signals and challenge incomplete or weak technical updates.

Service operations and ITIL

Experience working within ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and service-request processes with strong ticket hygiene.

Communication and handoffs

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide concise bridge updates and high-quality handoffs across shifts.

Problem solving under ambiguity

Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, prioritize quickly, and keep progress moving.

Ownership and teamwork

Strong sense of ownership, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cloud platform support, AI platform support, complex enterprise application support, or NOC / command-center style operations.
  • Experience coordinating high-priority incidents in an ITIL-aligned environment with strong documentation discipline.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, bridge tooling, service reporting, shift handoffs, and working in a managed-services model.
  • Comfort working across offshore and onshore support teams with shared ownership and tight communication loops.

Working Style & Core Behaviors

  • Stays calm and methodical when incidents are noisy, urgent, or under-defined.
  • Knows how to separate signal from noise and keep the bridge focused on the next best action.
  • Works well with engineers, service desk teams, vendors, and leadership without waiting for perfect direction.
  • Pushes for clarity, evidence, and ownership while still being collaborative and pragmatic.
  • Treats clean handoffs and documentation as part of the job, not admin work.

What Good Looks Like

  • Can take control of a live incident quickly and make it obvious what the team is doing and why.
  • Keeps technical responders focused, escalates at the right time, and does not let issues drift.
  • Hands off incidents cleanly to onshore leadership without losing context or forcing rework.
  • Turns repeated failure patterns into better runbooks, monitoring, and support discipline.

Team Context

You will join PwCs AI Operations & Platform Support team supporting clients run-state AI environment. The operating model is centered on Level 2 and Level 3 support, monitoring, incident response, service requests, minor enhancements, and continuous improvement across AWS/Bedrock, OpenAI, and related platform components.

This role will work in a managed-services model focused on incident management, service requests, monitoring, minor enhancements, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. Success depends not only on technical skill, but also on ownership, collaboration, and the ability to engage stakeholders to progress work.

title: Agentic AI Developer
jobDescription:
We're looking for an Agentic AI Developer who lives at the intersection of applied LLM engineering and production software. You'll design and ship the AI agents and orchestration flows at the core of Synthetix reasoning loops, tool use, multi-agent coordination, memory, and the governance rails that keep them trustworthy.

You're comfortable across the stack, but your center of gravity is agent creation: turning a capability into a reliable, observable, evaluable agent. This is a hands-on builder role — you'll prototype fast, harden what works, and own agents from design through production.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship AI agents using modern agent frameworks — OpenAI Agents SDK, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), Microsoft Agent Framework / AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents — picking the right tool for each problem.
  • Architect multi-agent orchestration and stateful workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, and similar frameworks: planning, routing, hand-offs, retries, and durable long-running execution.
  • Implement robust tool / function calling, structured outputs, and external-system integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and connectors.
  • Build the retrieval and memory layers — RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and short- and long-term agent memory.
  • Bake in governance from day one: guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and safe-failure behavior — the governed in governed orchestration.
  • Stand up evaluation and observability — agent evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and telemetry (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry) — to measure and continuously improve agent reliability.
  • Integrate agents into full-stack applications across APIs, services, and front-end surfaces, collaborating closely with platform, product, and design.
  • Optimize for cost, latency, and quality across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic / Claude, Google / Gemini, and open-weight models).

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful recent hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong Python (the working language of agent development) and solid TypeScript / JavaScript for full-stack integration.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework / SDK (OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and one orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent).
  • A solid grasp of LLM building blocks: prompting, function / tool calling, structured outputs, context-window management, RAG, and embeddings / vector databases.
  • Full-stack fluency: REST / async APIs (FastAPI, NestJS, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL), and enough front-end (React) to build and integrate end-to-end.
  • Familiarity with cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD.
  • A product mindset, strong debugging instincts, and the judgment to make non-deterministic systems behave reliably.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, and similar).
  • Experience with MCP, Temporal or other durable-execution engines, and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to enterprise / regulated environments — SSO, RBAC, data governance, and compliance.
  • Fine-tuning, prompt-optimization, or model-routing experience.
  • Open-source contributions in the agent / LLM ecosystem.

About Us:


CLOUDSUFI, a Google Cloud Premier Partner, is a global leading provider of data-driven digital transformation across cloud-based enterprises. With a global presence and focus on Software & Platforms, Life sciences and Healthcare, Retail, CPG, financial services and supply chain, CLOUDSUFI is positioned to meet customers where they are in their data monetization journey.


Our Values

We are a passionate and empathetic team that prioritizes human values. Our purpose is to elevate the quality of lives for our family, customers, partners and the community.


Equal Opportunity Statement

CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/


About the role


Role Summary: Software Engineer, Internal AI Products


A Software Engineer who builds the tools this company runs on. You build agent loops, and the loops build the solutions. You work towards a Company Brain that anyone here can ask.35 years’ experience • Reports to the CFO • 


THE KEY SKILL:

You build the agent loops that build the solutions. You will not write every automation by hand. You build the loops that
write them. Ship a prototype every week. You ship something every day.

You’ll be building a Company Brain with access control. One system that holds what the company knows about finance,delivery and people. Anyone can ask it a question. Each person sees only what they are cleared to see.

One hard filter. If you cannot write and debug production code, and have not done it before, please do not apply.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work the backlog: You pick items off a live, ranked backlog. You learn each function by building inside it. There is no discovery phase. What you learn goes back into the backlog and changes what comes next.
  • Build the product: You design, build and ship tools that people use every day. Reconciliation, MIS, the deal desk,quote to cash, or whatever the real bottleneck turns out to be. You choose the tools and frameworks.
  • Wire the data: Connect the systems each team already uses, so that the same number means the same thing everywhere.
  • Make it visible: You build live dashboards and alerts that leaders read on their own, instead of asking someone for a report.
  • Keep it running: You own uptime and accuracy for everything you build. Anything that touches money or people needs a person in the loop.

THE STACK:


  • Build with: Python and TypeScript. You write production code. Frontier model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with tool calling and structured output. At least one agent framework. MCP to connect agents to internal systems.Postgres and pgvector, or something similar, for retrieval. You deploy on GCP, and you debug your own work.
  • Work in agents daily: Claude Code, Cursor or something like them, as the way you write code every day. You should have a clear view on how to run the loop, and on when a person has to step in.
  • Connect to: The systems we already run on for accounting, CRM, hiring and IT support, along with Google Workspace.Most of the work is getting them to agree with each other.
  • Check what you ship: Anything that produces a number needs a way to catch it going quietly wrong. Test sets, regression checks, and alerts on the output as well as on the job.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE:

  • Something you built is running by week two, and someone is using it.
    • By day 90, time spent on reconciliation or reporting is down by a number you can defend to the CFO.
    • Every tool you ship has a named owner who is still using it 60 days later. That is the measure that counts.
    • Leaders stop asking for numbers, because they can already see them.
    • By the end of your first year, a first version of the Company Brain answers real questions about Finance, and each
    person who asks sees only what they are cleared to see.

WHO THIS IS FOR:

  • You have built products: 3 to 5 years at a software product company, on a product with real users at scale. That means 100k+ monthly active users, or heavy daily use by a large enterprise customer base. You have owned code in production, in front of real users, long after it shipped.
    • You ship alone: You are comfortable as the only engineer in the room, and the only person on call for what you built.
    • You work out new ground fast: A domain you do not know is interesting to you. You start without waiting for a spec or an expert.
    • You are fluent with agents: One person cannot cover a whole company by hand. You use agent loops heavily and youare good at it.
    • You write and speak clearly: Half this job is pulling a process out of a finance or delivery lead and giving it back to them correctly. You work remotely, so this matters a great deal.

HOW WE WILL ASSESS:
• A design problem: Live. We give you a function of the B2B company, and you design the system for it. We watch how you break down a domain you do not know, how you size it, and what you leave out on purpose.
• A build exercise: Live and screen-shared, on your own setup, with your own agents. You build the way you normally build. We watch how you run the loop, when you step in, and what you decide to skip.
• Your work and your questions: We talk about what you have shipped before. You ask us whatever you want.

Communication is not a separate round. All three sessions are live, and how clearly you explain your thinking is part of how we judge you.


WHERE IT LEADS
You report to the CEO and CFO from your first day. Your charter covers the whole company. Nothing sits between you and production. Very few engineering jobs offer all three at once, and that is why this one exists.
In 18 months you will know how this company really runs: the data, the money, and the gaps between teams. The rolethen changes shape to fit whatever the biggest open problem is by then.

Data, AI & Analytics

  • Exposure to IoT-enabled monitoring platforms for generation and network assets

Cloud & Integration

  • Delivery experience on cloud platforms - Azure, AWS, or Oracle in a utility/energy context
  • Understanding of integration architecture - APIs, middleware, legacy modernization
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and data governance considerations in OT environments

CLIENT & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

  • Proven ability to manage senior client relationships - CXOs, Directors, and Programme Sponsors
  • Experience engaging utility regulators, government bodies, and policy stakeholders
  • Ability to navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments across client, vendor, and internal teams

  • Track record of identifying and converting scope expansion, add-on work, and new opportunities

PEOPLE & PRACTICE DEVELOPMENT

jobDescription:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we are on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One.


Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our offshore Data Platform engineering team. This is a hands-on leadership role you will drive the design, delivery, and governance of our enterprise data platform while managing a high-performing team of data engineers and architects. You will serve as the offshore anchor for platform strategy, working closely with onshore product and architecture teams across time zones.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency across cloud-native data platforms (Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake), strong data governance credentials including hands-on Collibra experience, and a proven track record of leading teams through complex, multi-stakeholder data initiatives.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 8-15 data engineers, architects, and analysts based offshore
  • Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery cadence in alignment with onshore product priorities
  • Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and platform reliability standards
  • Act as the primary offshore point of contact for escalations, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder communication
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and psychological safety within the team


Data Platform Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and evolve the enterprise data platform spanning ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption layers
  • Design and implement solutions on Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Snowflake selecting the right engine per use case and cost profile
  • Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, ELT/ETL pipeline design, performance tuning, and platform scalability
  • Drive Modern Data Stack adoption: dbt, Delta Lake / Iceberg, Unity Catalog, and cloud-native orchestration (ADF, Apache Airflow / ADB Workflows)
  • Oversee API and data product layer design in alignment with domain-driven architecture principles


Data Governance & Quality

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing operation of the Collibra data governance platform covering business glossary, data catalog, lineage, policy management, and stewardship workflows
  • Define and enforce data ownership, classification, and access control frameworks across Synapse, Databricks (Unity Catalog), and Snowflake
  • Partner with data stewards and domain leads to operationalize metadata management and data quality SLAs
  • Champion GDPR, data residency, and regulatory compliance requirements at the platform level
  • Drive data observability practices using tools such as Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or equivalent
  • Integrate Collibra with upstream and downstream systems to maintain end-to-end data lineage across the enterprise


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with onshore architecture, product, and BI teams to translate strategic data needs into platform roadmap items
  • Engage with Salesforce, MDM, and CRM integration teams to ensure clean, governed data flows into the platform
  • Partner with cloud engineering and DevSecOps on platform infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and FinOps (cloud cost optimization)
  • Communicate platform health, roadmap progress, and risk clearly to senior leadership


Required Qualifications


Experience

  • 10+ years in data engineering or data platform roles, with at least 3 years in an engineering management or team lead capacity
  • Proven offshore delivery leadership managing distributed teams across geographies and time zones
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a cloud data platform in a production enterprise environment


Technical Skills Platforms

  • Azure Synapse Analytics: Dedicated and Serverless SQL pools, Spark Pools, Synapse Pipelines, integration with ADLS Gen2
  • Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, cluster management, and cost optimization
  • Snowflake: Data sharing, Snowpark, dynamic data masking, RBAC, query performance tuning, and Snowflake cost governance


Technical Skills Data Governance

  • Collibra: Business glossary, data catalog, lineage configuration, stewardship workflow design, Collibra DQ, and integration with cloud data platforms
  • Data classification, sensitive data handling (PII/PCI), and policy enforcement at the platform layer
  • Familiarity with Unity Catalog (Databricks) and Snowflake''s native governance controls as complements to Collibra


Technical Skills Engineering

  • Strong SQL and Python; working knowledge of Scala or Java is a plus
  • dbt (data build tool) model design, testing, documentation
  • Data pipeline orchestration: Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or Databricks Workflows
  • CI/CD for data: version control, automated testing, and deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions)
  • Data modeling: dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2.0, or medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
  • MDM concepts and integration patterns; Salesforce data integration experience is an advantage


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) platforms (Informatica MDM, Reltio, or equivalent)
  • Exposure to event-driven data architectures: Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or Databricks Structured Streaming


Leadership Competencies

  • Bias for ownership: Takes accountability for platform outcomes, not just team activity
  • Technical credibility: Earns trust with engineers through depth, not just title
  • Asynchronous communication: Writes clearly, documents decisions, and bridges the offshore-onshore gap effectively
  • Talent development: Builds career paths, runs structured 1:1s, and grows the team''s capability over time
  • Stakeholder management: Translates business intent into engineering priorities without losing either side


Shift Timings - 11 AM - 8 PM


Location - Chennai

jobDescription:
Supply Chain: Supplier Onboarding Functional Specialist
This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.
Who We Are
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves together and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.
Job Description
HPE s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking , with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) program , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a single platform , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
As part of a fast-moving, multi-year transformation , the team will stabilize near-term operations, migrate core platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help build a new business unit from its earliest days , rather than inherit someone else s systems. You will gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale platform integration and cross-functional program leadership , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
Workstream-Specific Details
What you ll do:
Responsibilities
  • The Supplier Onboarding - Supply Chain Functional Analyst is responsible for delivering comprehensive SAP S/4HANA solutions across sales, materials management, and logistics execution functions. This role requires deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA, combined with hands-on experience in full lifecycle implementations and system integration. The candidate will drive order-to-cash optimization, logistics execution excellence, and supply chain automation while leveraging advanced tools and intelligent systems to enhance process efficiency and data quality. This role is critical to HPEs supply chain transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Lead functional design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA - SD, MM, and LE modules, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Analyze complex business requirements and develop conceptual and detailed designs for order fulfillment, logistics execution, and supply chain processes.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA systems for sales order processing, delivery management, shipping, picking, packing, goods issue, and route determination.
  • Support the design and optimization of logistics execution workflows including outbound delivery, stock transport orders (STO), and shipment processing.
  • Manage order-to-cash process implementation covering order booking, sourcing, order scheduling, buy-sell processes, and fulfillment.
  • Design and document product structures, bill of materials (BOM), and production models including build-to-stock, configure-to-order, and make-to-order scenarios.
  • Lead system integration efforts including interface design and configuration with both SAP and non-SAP systems using iDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and APIs.
  • Write detailed technical specifications for ABAP custom program development and coordinate with development teams on implementation and testing.
  • Perform comprehensive testing activities including functional testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Support the implementation of intelligent process automation solutions for routine supply chain and logistics tasks.
  • Troubleshoot complex configuration issues, system integration problems, and process discrepancies across SAP and integrated systems.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including process flows, configuration guides, technical specifications, and user procedures.
  • Identify areas for process improvement and system optimization, leveraging data analytics and process insights.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, development teams, and cross-functional groups to ensure successful solution delivery.
  • Work effectively in distributed, multi-geography team environments and mentor junior functional resources.
What you need to bring:
Education And Experience Required
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related field.

HPE s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking , with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet . You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.

jobDescription:
Role: Senior Integration Data Engineer

Location: India, Remote

Experience: 10+ Years

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Integration Engineer to design, implement and operate reliable integrations between a cloud data platform and an established data-processing application. The role will focus on building production-grade integration solutions, ensuring data consistency, compatibility, traceability and seamless processing across multiple services.

  • Evaluate and recommend whether to modify existing applications, introduce adapters, or use shared data models.

  • 9+ years of experience building and operating production-grade data integrations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and data formats such as XML and JSON.
  • Strong understanding of batch processing and change-data processing.
  • Experience developing integration adapters and transformation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, logging, retries and replay mechanisms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and trace data across multiple services and processing layers.

Must have skills

  • Python and SQL
  • API and data processing
  • XML/JSON
  • Batch and change-data processing
  • Integration adapters and data transformations
  • Automated testing
  • Error handling, logging, retry and replay
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end data flow and record traceability

Good to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with MongoDB and Solr.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices.

Desired attributes

  • Ability to make sound architectural decisions around adapters, application changes and shared models.
  • Strong focus on data accuracy, reliability and system compatibility.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive CLM Operations Executive to join the Paytm for
Business Campaign Lifecycle Management (CLM)central team. In this role, you will be responsible for
the end-to-end execution of Off-deck (whatsapp, Push, SMS, Emailer) and On-deck (banners, icons,

Growth, and Traffic teams to ensure campaigns are set up accurately, approved on time, and
monitored for performance.

Key Responsibilities
Campaign Execution Management
- Create, configure, and publish campaigns on CleverTap across Push (Override, Lifecycle,
Nodedupe, Event-based), Email, SMS, Chat, and WhatsApp channels.
- Set up and manage CleverTap Journeys, including event-based triggers, audience
segmentation, and multi-step flows.
- Set up and validate context strings for both Override and Lifecycle on-deck campaigns (Native
Display).
Data Fetching Validation
- Fetch and validate campaign base sizes using CleverTaps segment builder and cross-
reference against push campaign base size checks.
- Validate Banner IDs, deeplinks (via QR code generation), widget types, slot IDs, and image
specs before campaign scheduling.
- Monitor campaign delivery metrics post-launch; flag anomalies such as unusual drop in reach or
delivery rates (expected benchmark: 50-60% delivery/acquiry).
- Pull and verify data from the Campaign Tracker, Traffic Approval Sheet, and Allocation Team
Sheet to ensure alignment.
- Ensure all campaigns have a valid Label ID from the CLM Category List, and that CategoryId
and CategoryName key-value pairs are correctly mapped (case-sensitive).
Quality Control Scheduling
- Perform QC checks as per the Campaign SOP before scheduling any campaign.
- Conduct banner QC in line with Banner SOP guidelines, verifying image specs, deeplinks, and
widget types.
- Test campaigns during permitted testing hours (7:00 AM-10:00 PM) using the designated test
webhook.

Required Skills Qualifications
CleverTap Expertise (Mandatory)
- Hands-on experience with CleverTap for campaign creation, audience segmentation, and
channel configuration.
- Proficient in setting up Events and Journeys in CleverTap, including multi-step flows, event
triggers, and user property filters.
- Understanding of CleverTap concepts: Native Display, Push campaigns, cascade mode, sub-
contexts, frequency capping, and DND settings.
- Familiarity with webhook configuration (live and test) for Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and
Chat channels.
- Hands-on with AI usage to execute more campaigns in shorter duration.
- Basic understanding of other communication tools like Meta/WhatsApp, ConnectPlus (Tokom).
Data Fetching Analytical Skills
- Ability to fetch, validate, and cross-reference campaign data from multiple trackers and sheets
(Google Sheets / Excel).
- Basic understanding of segmentation logic: user properties, behavioral filters, segment
exclusions, and frequency rules.
- Ability to identify and flag data discrepancies or campaign mismatches quickly and accurately.
Operational Process Skills
- Strong attention to detail - ability to follow multi-step SOPs precisely and maintain zero-miss
campaign execution and ability to manage repetitive operational tasks.
- Experience raising and tracking tickets on Jira or similar tools
- Good time management skills to handle approval deadlines, testing windows, and scheduling
timelines simultaneously.
- Proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

jobDescription:
Senior Python Engineer Data & Generation Pipelines

5+ years of experience

Full-time - Hyderabad

About the role

You'll own RedTee's data pipelines end to end. You'll start by building the scraping, cleaning, and LLM-based extraction pipelines that construct our knowledge base the source of truth the whole product depends on. As the product matures, you'll expand into the asset generation pipeline that turns knowledge into video, audio, and diagram content.

This role is for someone who thinks in pipelines: retries, idempotency, quality gates, cost per unit, provenance. You've built systems that call unreliable external services thousands of times a day and stay standing. You know the difference between a script that works once and a pipeline that runs unattended for months.


Must have

5+ years of production Python. Hands-on production experience with at least 3 of the following:

Web scraping at scale Playwright, Selenium (production, not test automation), Scrapy, or equivalent. You've dealt with rate limits, anti-bot measures, proxies, and JS-rendered content.

Pipeline orchestration Celery, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or custom async orchestrators with retry, backoff, and dead-letter handling.

LLM API integration OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar, with retry, fallback, structured output parsing, and cost tracking. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or hand-rolled.

Text extraction and cleaning HTML, PDF, and messy real-world documents. Tools like unstructured.io, trafilatura, pdfplumber, BeautifulSoup.

Vector databases and embedding pipelines pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or similar.


Not a fit for this role:

Pure CRUD backend developers (Django-only, DRF-only)

QA engineers whose Selenium experience is test automation

Data scientists without production engineering experience

Anyone whose LLM experience stops at API demos or tutorials


What you'll build


First 6 months knowledge base pipelines:

Scrapers for course content sources with retry, dedup, and freshness detection

Text cleaning and chunking pipelines (HTML/PDF structured content with provenance)

Multi-agent LLM extraction and corroboration pipeline (Scout, Extractor, Corroborator, Librarian, Auditor)

Hash-versioning, provenance tracking, and incremental update system for the knowledge base

Vector store and retrieval layer feeding downstream course generation


Later expand into the asset generation pipeline:


Orchestrator that takes a structured spec and returns tagged, quality-checked assets

Integration of code-based renderers (Manim, Mermaid, D3, Motion Canvas), the Remotion video compositor, and paid APIs for TTS, avatars, and video

Automated evaluation layer that scores every generated asset before it enters the library

Cost monitoring and optimization across all paid APIs


Good to have


FFmpeg, headless browser rendering (Puppeteer, Playwright), or video compositing experience

Node/JavaScript familiarity our video compositor Remotion is React/Node-based

Cost optimization or API spend management on high-volume generative systems

Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) for automated content evaluation

Familiarity with model aggregators (fal.ai, Replicate) or self-hosting open-source models

A GitHub or public work sample showing pipeline or LLM orchestration work


Why join


Own the data spine the entire product depends on. The knowledge base you build determines the quality of every course RedTee ever produces.

Greenfield system design take working prototypes and turn them into a production pipeline, then expand your scope into generation.

Work at the intersection of scraping, LLM orchestration, and cost engineering, where the hard problem is reliability and unit economics, not novelty.

Direct influence on the technical direction of the platform. Your calls shape what we can and can't do.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Load Forecasting Engineer to develop and validate advanced load forecasting solutions for electrical distribution networks from 66 kV downstream to edge points.

The role focuses on predicting future electricity demand to support grid planning, infrastructure optimization, demand management, and DER integration, including solar PV, electric vehicles, and energy storage.

The ideal candidate should combine strong power-system and distribution-network knowledge with expertise in time-series forecasting, AI/ML modeling, and data-driven analysis.

  • Develop and validate short-term and long-term load forecasting models for electrical distribution networks.

  • Process and analyze smart-meter data, including data cleaning, missing-data handling, outlier detection, and aggregation.
  • Map load data spatially across relevant network assets, including substations and feeders.
  • Incorporate external demand drivers such as temperature, humidity, holidays, weekends, and economic indicators.
  • Develop probabilistic forecasts and stochastic scenarios to assess forecasting uncertainty and future demand risks.
  • Evaluate the impact of solar, EVs, energy storage, and other DERs on load patterns and network demand.
  • Establish appropriate forecasting benchmarks and validation methods to assess model performance.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data science, and software teams to integrate forecasting models into distribution-grid planning and analytical applications.
  • Translate engineering requirements into forecasting methodologies and computational models.

Required Qualifications

  • M.Tech / Ph.D. in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 510 years of relevant professional experience in load forecasting, distribution systems, power-system planning, or a related domain.
  • Strong understanding of electrical distribution networks, load behavior, and demand patterns.
  • Proven experience in developing and validating electricity load forecasting models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to work with large-scale and high-resolution datasets.
  • Proficiency in Python and relevant data analytics or machine-learning frameworks.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and collaborate with engineering, data science, and software teams.

Core Technical Skills

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Load Forecasting
  • Time-Series & AI/ML Modeling
  • LSTM, Attention-Based & Regression Models
  • Smart-Meter Data Processing & Analysis
  • Substation & Feeder-Level Load Analysis
  • Exogenous Variable Integration
  • Probabilistic Forecasting & Uncertainty Analysis
  • Stochastic Scenario Generation
  • DER Impact Assessment

Preferred / Additional Expertise

  • Experience with distribution-level forecasting across substations, feeders, and downstream/edge points.
  • Experience with spatial/network-based load mapping and distribution-system datasets.
  • Exposure to forecasting challenges associated with high solar PV, EV, and energy-storage penetration.
  • Knowledge of utility planning and distribution-grid applications where load forecasts support capacity and infrastructure decisions.
  • Experience working with large-scale smart-meter or AMI datasets.
  • Understanding of grid modernization and data-driven distribution-system applications.
  • Familiarity with power-system simulation or distribution-network analysis tools would be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a Load Forecasting Engineer who can combine electrical distribution-system knowledge with advanced forecasting and AI/ML capabilities.

The candidate should be comfortable working with complex network data, developing reliable forecasting models, assessing uncertainty and changing demand patterns, and collaborating with multidisciplinary technical teams.

title: Deputy Unit Manager - AI Unit
jobDescription:
Job Purpose

We are looking for a Senior UI Developer to build a modern, conversational user interface for an enterprise AI platform. This role focuses on creating a clean, minimal, and highly interactive single-page experience where users interact primarily through conversation rather than traditional screens. You will work closely with backend, AI, and SDK teams to translate system responses into intuitive, dynamic UI components. The role involves building complex animations, handling multimodal inputs, ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews, and maintaining high code quality suitable for large-scale production systems.

Duties and Responsibilities

Conversational UI Frontend Development Design and build a single-page, conversational UI that replaces traditional multi-screen flows. Develop dynamic, schema-driven UI components that render based on user intent, profile, and system capabilities. Implement fluid animations, transitions, and motion systems while ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews and browsers. Build support for multimodal inputs and outputs including text, voice, image, and file interactions. Ensure UI adapts gracefully across devices, channels (WebView vs browser), and capability constraints. UI Architecture Code Quality Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and state management patterns. Build reusable, well-structured UI components with clear separation of concerns. Ensure code is clean, maintainable, and easy for other developers to understand and extend. Work closely with backend teams to consume UI schemas, capability flags, and conversational state. Performance, Security Stability Optimize bundle size, rendering performance, and animation smoothness for low-end devices. Implement fallback and degradation strategies for constrained environments. Follow secure frontend practices including CSP compliance, PII masking, and safe handling of user inputs. Support analytics, audit events, and session tracking hooks as required by enterprise standards. Collaboration Delivery Collaborate with AI, backend, SDK, and product teams to translate conversational responses into effective UI. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and iterative UI improvements. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments.

Key Decisions / Dimensions

UI Design Implementation Decisions Choosing appropriate UI patterns for conversational and single-task interfaces instead of traditional page-based navigation. Deciding when UI behavior should be driven by backend schemas versus handled locally in the frontend. Selecting animation and motion techniques that balance visual richness with performance constraints. Deciding fallback and degradation strategies for low-end devices, WebView limitations, and browser constraints. Framework Component Decisions Defining reusable UI components and interaction patterns to be used across journeys. Choosing libraries or native implementations for animations, gestures, and multimodal interactions. Deciding how to structure components to keep them extensible and easy to maintain. Ensuring configuration-driven UI is preferred over hardcoded logic wherever possible. Performance, Security Stability Decisions Deciding trade-offs between UI complexity and runtime performance. Implementing safe handling and rendering of user inputs, media, and AI responses. Deciding what data is rendered, masked, or excluded in the UI for compliance and audit needs. Testing UI changes across devices, OS versions, and integration environments before release.

Major Challenges

Building a highly dynamic, conversational UI that replaces traditional screen-based navigation without confusing users. Delivering fluid, futuristic animations and rich visual effects while maintaining performance inside mobile WebViews and low-end devices. Handling multimodal inputs and outputs reliably across different devices, browsers, and mobile OS versions. Working within strict security, privacy, and compliance constraints while implementing advanced UI interactions. Adapting UI behavior based on user capabilities, channel limitations, and backend-driven schemas. Debugging and optimizing UI issues that span frontend code, WebView behavior, SDK integration, and backend responses. Maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture as UI logic becomes increasingly dynamic and personalized.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 34 years of hands-on frontend development experience. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Experience with modern frontend frameworks (Svelte, React, or equivalent). Experience building dynamic, single-page, component-based applications. Hands-on experience with animations, transitions, and motion systems. Experience handling multimodal inputs (text, voice, image, file). Familiarity with WebView constraints and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST/gRPC). Performance, Security Quality Knowledge of frontend performance optimization and bundle management. Awareness of frontend security practices and safe input handling. Experience integrating analytics, audit events, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds.

    • RAG and vector search experience - chunking strategy, retrieval design, grounding
    • Proven solid production-grade Python and SQL
    • Databricks fluency: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Genie spaces, AI functions

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Engineer with a strong focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI to design, build, and deploy intelligent, LLM-powered systems. Youll work on prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning, while building robust backend services in Java and Python - with React front-end knowledge as a plus to help ship end-to-end AI features.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications - chatbots, copilots, agents, RAG systems, and summarization/extraction pipelines

  • Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines - embeddings, chunking strategies, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, pgvector)
  • Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs (open-source and closed-source) using techniques like LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, and RLHF where applicable
  • Design and implement agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration
  • Build backend services and APIs in Java and/or Python to serve LLM applications at scale
  • Implement evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs - accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost, and safety metrics
  • Manage prompt versioning, model routing, and caching for cost/performance optimization across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models)
  • Collaborate with front-end developers (or contribute directly in React) to surface LLM features in user-facing products
  • Monitor deployed LLM systems for drift, degradation, and safety/guardrail violations; iterate on mitigation strategies
  • Implement guardrails, content filtering, and responsible AI practices (bias mitigation, prompt injection defense, data privacy)
  • Stay current with the fast-moving LLM/GenAI landscape (new models, techniques, tooling) and assess applicability to the business

  • Experience with vector databases and embedding models
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Solid understanding of transformer architecture and how LLMs work under the hood
  • Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs for AI-serving backends
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) and working with Hugging Face Transformers
  • Experience designing multi-agent systems or tool-using/agentic AI workflows
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools (RAGAS, DeepEval, promptfoo, human-in-the-loop eval pipelines)

Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI / GenAI Engineer who combines strong Python engineering skills with practical experience building production-oriented RAG and Agentic AI solutions.

This is a builder role for an independent, self-driven engineer who can take ownership of a problem, understand the underlying business objective and cost implications, define a sensible technical approach, and drive the solution through implementation without requiring continuous direction.

Core Requirements

Python Engineering

  • Strong hands-on Python programmingskills with a sound understanding of OOP and software engineering principles.
  • Ability to write clean, modular, maintainable and production-quality code.
  • Experience developing APIs using Python frameworks; FastAPI is preferred.

RAG

  • Hands-on experience implementing an end-to-end RAG pipeline, covering data ingestion, retrieval, context preparation and response generation.
  • Practical experience with retrieval techniques such as:
    • Hybrid search/retrieval
    • Reranking
    • Query rewriting
  • Exposure to advanced RAG approaches such as Agentic RAG, Corrective RAG and HyDE.
  • Understanding of RAG/LLM response evaluation, preferably using frameworks such as RAGAS or TruLens.

Agentic AI

  • Hands-on experience building agent-based AI workflowsusing an orchestration framework, preferably LangGraph or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of agent workflow design, including nodes, edges, state management and orchestration.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with tools/tool calling.
  • Understanding or implementation experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Graph Databases

  • Practical hands-on experience with a graph database, such as Neo4j or equivalent.

Azure / Cloud

  • Hands-on cloud implementation experience; Azure is preferred.
  • Relevant experience may include:
    • Azure AI Search
    • Azure Cosmos DB
    • Azure AI Document Intelligence
    • Azure AI Foundry
    • Azure Application Insights

Added Advantage

Exposure to data engineering technologies such as:

  • Apache Airflow
  • PySpark
  • Azure Data Factory

What We Specifically Look For

We are looking for someone with strong engineering ownership who can independently initiate and drive work rather than wait for detailed instructions.

The candidate should be able to:

  • Understand the business problem and objectivebehind a technical requirement.
  • Consider cost, budget and operational implicationswhen making engineering decisions.
  • Independently structure the technical approach and drive implementation.
  • Challenge or improve existing approaches when there is a better solution.
  • Demonstrate strong coding and problem-solving ability, not just theoretical GenAI knowledge.
  • Show genuine passion for engineering and AI, with evidence of personally building, experimenting and solving real-world problems.

This is not a purely theoretical or prompt-engineering role. We are looking for a strong programmer and hands-on AI engineer who can take GenAI solutions from problem definition through implementation and connect the technology to measurable business needs.

If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer with 2 to 5 years of experience to build, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered features directly into our products. About the Role

We're hiring an outcome-focused Implementation & AI QA Engineer who blends technical rigor with client-facing judgment. This isn't a script-and-log role you'll be the bridge between client expectations, AI-driven applications, and platform performance, owning the validation of Salesforce configurations, AI workflows (including Agentforce and digital workers), and custom integrations that drive real business outcomes.

You'll partner closely with clients, developers, business analysts, architects, and implementation teams translating business requirements into test strategy, flagging risk early, and making sure what ships is reliable and measurable.

You'll test and help shape some of the most advanced AI and Salesforce work being built today, working directly with clients and cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. Client-Facing Quality & Implementation

Salesforce & Functional Testing

Integration & API Testing

Outcome-Based Test Strategy

If you want to build, own, and see your impact - join Skillz and level up your career.
Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real-money, skill-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didnt just enter the competitive gaming market - we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real-stakes competition possible at scale.
Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
Today, Skillz is part of FIRY - a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR , our AI-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000+ daily tournaments. $7.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.
Were a high-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA , Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY , Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters - and be part of a team that fights for what it builds - Skillz is the right place.
About the Role
Skillz is looking for a Manager, Talent Acquisition to join our Bangalore team as second-in-command to the Senior Manager, TA. This is a hybrid role that blends hands-on recruiting with day-to-day team leadership. Youll own priority searches yourself while coaching and guiding a team of recruiters to hire high-quality talent across our technical and business functions.

  • Uphold hiring standards and process consistency to protect candidate experience and hit timelines.
  • Lead offer negotiations and closing conversations, managing compensation expectations and counteroffers to land great talent within budget.
  • Build lasting relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and stakeholders across the business.
  • Support the Senior Manager, TA in driving down time-to-fill and minimizing the productivity loss that comes with open roles.
Key Competencies
  • Team Leadership Coaching - guiding recruiters, setting expectations, and improving team performance.
  • Technical Business Acumen - fluent in evaluating engineering, product, and data talent from Tier 1 B2C companies.
  • Strategic Recruiting - translating priorities into search strategies, market maps, and hiring plans.
  • Stakeholder Management - building credibility with leaders and constructively challenging requirements.
  • Execution Accountability - strong ownership of outcomes, timelines, and candidate experience.
  • Data-Driven Decision-Making - using metrics to spot risk and improve outcomes.
  • Problem-Solving Adaptability - resolving bottlenecks and thriving amid shifting priorities.
  • Offer Negotiation Closing - managing compensation conversations and counteroffers with confidence.
  • Relationship Building - sustaining trust across candidates, recruiters, and stakeholders.
Experience
  • 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record hiring technical, product, data, or business talent.
  • 1-2+ years formally managing, mentoring, or leading recruiters day-to-day.
  • Demonstrated success hiring Tier 1 talent from B2C technology, consumer internet, gaming, fintech, e-commerce, travel-tech, food-tech, or other scaled consumer businesses.
  • Experience running priority or hard-to-fill searches independently while overseeing other recruiters delivery.
  • Strong direct-sourcing skills; experience with building market maps and proactive pipelines without heavy reliance on agencies.
  • End-to-end recruitment lifecycle experience: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debriefs, references, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
  • Background in a startup, turnaround, or fast-scaling environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • A track record of tenure and growth; ideally two-plus years at one or more organizations, with internal promotions or expanded scope.

  • Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate and work regularly from the Skillz Bangalore office.

Location: Hybrid in Bangalore, India

Why Skillz
  • Youre building infrastructure, not just features. Skillz is the competition layer for mobile gaming - the matchmaking, payments, identity, and fraud systems that make real-stakes competition trustworthy at scale. The work here compounds. Every improvement to the platform makes every tournament on it better.
  • Founder-led. Andrew Paradise founded Skillz in 2012 with a single conviction: that fair, real-money skill-based competition should exist at scale. Thirteen years later, he s taken the company public on the NYSE , built a portfolio of three independent businesses, earned 90+ patents, and won the largest false advertising verdict in U.S. history. He is still here - still the founder, still the CEO, still building. That kind of long-term commitment and alignment is rare in any company. At Skillz, it defines the culture from the top down.

Your work spans gaming, ad tech, identity, payments, and ecommerce. The platform you build on gets smarter and more valuable with every player, developer, and advertiser that enters the ecosystem.

title: Application Security Engineer
jobDescription:
Application Security Engineer
The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert with direct experience in a wide range of security technologies, tools, and methodologies. The role is suited for an experienced Application Security engineer with proven understanding in enterprise security and AI security and will focus on building toolsets and processes to drive adoption of secure practices across the enterprise. The team fosters a collaborative environment and is building a best-in-class program to partner with the business to protect the Firms information and computer systems. Millennium is a complex and robust technical environment and securing the Firm from external and internal threats is a top priority.
Principal Responsibilities
  • AI Security Strategy: Define and implement security guardrails for Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic frameworks, ensuring safe enterprise adoption.
  • AI Risk Management: Conduct specialized threat modeling, red teaming, and risk assessments for AI/ML models (e.g., testing for prompt injection, model theft, and data poisoning).
  • Security Consulting: Lead risk management activities, including application risk assessments, design reviews, and mitigation strategies for IT projects.
  • Lifecycle Engagement: Engage throughout the SDLC to identify vulnerabilities, conduct code reviews/penetration testing, and enforce secure coding standards.
  • Program Development: Evangelize AppSec and AI security best practices through developer education, training materials, and outreach.
  • Tooling Architecture: Design robust security architectures and integrate automated security testing (SAST/DAST/SCA) into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Partner with Technology, Trading, Legal, and Compliance to create policies and communicate technical risks to non-technical stakeholders.
Qualifications/Skills Required
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT Security or related field.
  • 5+ years experience working as an Application Security Engineer, Software Engineer, or similar role.
  • Deep understanding of AI-specific risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs) and experience securing applications utilizing LLMs.
  • Experience working with AI models, Agentic frameworks and security risks associated with AI.
  • Experience in working with global teams, collaborating on code and presentations.
  • Demonstrated work experience in hybrid on-premise and Public Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Strong understanding of security architectures, secure configuration principles/coding practices, cryptography fundamentals and encryption protocols.
  • Experience with common SCM CI/CD technologies like GitHub, Jenkins, Artifactory, etc. and integrating Security Scanning and Vulnerability Management into the CI/CD Pipelines
  • Familiarity with static and dynamic security analysis tools, and SCA/SBOM solutions.
  • Hands on experience with Secrets Management Password Vault technologies such as Delinea Secret Server and/or Hashicorp Vault, etc.
  • Strong experience in secure programming in languages such as Python, Java, C++, C#, or similar.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
  • Familiarity with web application security testing tools and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of various security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, etc.
  • Knowledge of Linux, OS internals and containers is a plus.
  • Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or CEH are advantageous.

jobDescription:
Biostatistics Manager, Centralized Statistical Monitoring (CSM)
What you will do:
Amgens Center for Design and Analysis Organization has a new opportunity for a Biostatistics Manager to provide statistical expertise in support of Centralized Statistical Monitoring (CSM) across clinical development programs.
The ideal candidate will build machine learning models and other statistical models, as well as support their implementation and deployment through a good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Develop business requirements through collaborations with cross-functional stakeholders and the use of excellent communication skills. Experience with clinical trials and their data collection process, storage, quality, and use would be looked for. The latter will be particularly critical in a regulated environment.
In this role, you will leverage your experience as a biostatistician to contribute to the design, application, and continuous improvement of data-driven monitoring methods that support risk-based quality management (RBQM). You will apply your ML and AI skills to detect atypical data patterns, identify emerging quality risks, and enhance proactive oversight of clinical trials.
Functional requirements, prototype code, good documentation, testing, and relevant visualizations will be expected as deliverables when producing new algorithms as required by the stakeholders.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Provide statistical and data science expertise to support CSM activities across multiple studies and therapeutic areas.
  • Develop and enhance statistical, machine learning, and AI-guided methodologies, to strengthen CSM signal detection and site-level risk assessment.
  • Perform detailed statistical review and quality control of CSM outputs, signals, and study-level metrics to ensure accuracy, consistency, and appropriate interpretation prior to stakeholder communication.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (e.g., Clinical, Operations, Data Management, RBQM, Quality, Digital/Technology teams) to translate critical-to-quality (CTQ) factors into analytically robust and scalable monitoring solutions.
  • Contribute to validation, documentation, and controlled deployment of analytical methodologies and tools within regulated environments, ensuring reproducibility and adherence to internal standards.
  • Develop clear visualizations, dashboards, and analytical applications to enhance transparency and facilitate interpretation of monitoring outputs.
  • Stay current with evolving developments in data science, machine learning, and AI relevant to clinical trial monitoring.
  • Adhere to all Amgen policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
What we expect of you:
The statistical professional we seek is strong in the following qualifications.
Basic Qualifications:
  • MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field with 8years of Industrial experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Proficiency in statistical programming (e.g., R, SAS, or Python) with demonstrated experience applying machine learning and advanced analytical methods in practice.
  • Clinical trial experience within a pharmaceutical or medical research environment.
  • Prior experience serving as a study statistician for clinical trials, with responsibility for study-level statistical analysis and reporting.
  • Experience working effectively in a globally dispersed team environment with cross-cultural partners.
  • Demonstrable strategic thinking skills, originality, and creativity.
  • Writing skills with samples of technical writing (papers, reports, or project descriptions).
